 Western Digital's Black SN850 1TB SSD takes your machine to the next level of performance. The WD_Black SN850 features a PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe interface, 600TB endurance and 3D NAND memory chips. The WD_Black SN850 1TB (WDS100T1X0E) M.2 PCIe 4.0 4x NVMe SSD offers speeds of up to 7,000 MB/s read and 5,300 MB/s write and up to 1,000,000 IOPS (depending on model). Maps with long loading times and lags are a thing of the past.

Last price 699€95

Overview

 

## WD_Black SN850X: High-performance PCIe 4.0 SSD for Gamers

Hold on to blazing gaming speeds with the WD_Black SN850X NVMe SSD. Annihilate load times and reduce throttling and lag for a smooth, fast experience that lets you take on your opponents at their best. This dedicated gamer SSD is available in capacities from 1TB to 4TB, with an optional heatsink on the 1TB and 2TB drives to help maintain top-notch performance.

## At the SUMMUM of PCIe-Express 4.0

- Insane speeds of up to 7,300MB/s deliver top-notch performance with extremely fast load times.
- Extremely low latency loads graphics quickly with minimal jerk and lag for a smooth gaming experience.
- A range of capacities from 1TB to 4TB to keep more games at your fingertips and get into the action quickly.
